```{r clean workspace}
rm(list=ls())
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ei)
library(zipcodeR) #https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2665963821000373/
library(eiCompare)
library(RJSONIO)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r record package version}
used_packages <-loadedNamespaces()
used_package_versions <- tibble(package = used_packages)%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(version=packageVersion(package))

#write_csv(used_package_versions, "./Geographical location, income, & ADI linking package version.csv")
```

```{r read in data}
# this adi_fips data is not included in the data folder, see https://www.neighborhoodatlas.medicine.wisc.edu/ for data download
adi_fips<- read_csv("./adi-download/US_2020_ADI_Census\ Block\ Group_v3.2.csv")

raw_data <- read_csv("./data/exp-2/06.exp2-included-participants-forADI-linking.csv")
```

```{r prepare data}
data <- raw_data%>%
  filter(is.na(loc_fromIP)==F)%>%
  select(unique_id,loc_fromIP,zipcode_fromIP)%>%
  separate(loc_fromIP,into=c("lat","lon"),sep=",")%>%
  rename(zip=zipcode_fromIP)%>%
  mutate(zip_temp = as.character(zip))%>%
  mutate(zip = case_when(str_length(zip_temp)==4 ~ paste("0",zip_temp,sep=""),
                         TRUE ~ zip_temp))%>%
  select(-zip_temp)

missing_data <- raw_data%>%filter(is.na(loc_fromIP)==T)%>%select(unique_id,zip)
```

```{r}
lat_and_lon <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(missing_data)) {
  info <- reverse_zipcode(missing_data$zip[i])
  lat_and_lon[[i]] <- list(missing_data$unique_id[i],info$lat, info$lng, missing_data$zip[i])
}

lat_lon_df <- rbindlist(lat_and_lon)%>%rename(unique_id=V1, lat=V2, lon=V3,zip=V4)

data_all <- rbind(data,lat_lon_df)
```

```{r eiCompare: get 15 digits fips code}
census_block <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(data_all)) {
  census_block[[i]] <- latlong2fips(data_all$lat[i], data_all$lon[i], data_all$unique_id[i])
}

fips_df <- rbindlist(census_block)
```

```{r conversion and ADI mapping}
fips_df_12 <- fips_df%>%mutate(FIPS = str_sub(FIP,start=0,end=-4))%>%left_join(adi_fips)%>%rename(unique_id = row_id)

fips_ADI_for_export <- fips_df_12%>%select(unique_id,FIPS,ADI_NATRANK,ADI_STATERNK)
```

```{r zipcode R: get median household income}
data_all_zip <- data%>%select(unique_id,zip)%>%rbind(missing_data)

income <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(data_all_zip)) {
  info <- reverse_zipcode(data_all_zip$zip[i])
  income[[i]] <- list(data_all_zip$unique_id[i],info$median_household_income)
}

income_df <- rbindlist(income)%>%rename(unique_id=V1, zipcodeR_median_household_income = V2)
```

```{r}
missing_income <- income_df%>%filter(is.na(zipcodeR_median_household_income)==T)%>%left_join(raw_data)%>%select(unique_id,zip)

data_all_zip2 <- data_all_zip%>%filter(!unique_id %in% missing_income$unique_id)%>%rbind(missing_income)

income2 <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(data_all_zip2)) {
  info2 <- reverse_zipcode(data_all_zip2$zip[i])
  income2[[i]] <- list(data_all_zip2$unique_id[i],info2$median_household_income)
}

income_df2 <- rbindlist(income2)%>%rename(unique_id=V1, zipcodeR_median_household_income = V2)
```


```{r export both ADI and income measures}
db_for_export <- fips_ADI_for_export%>%left_join(income_df2)
write_csv(db_for_export,"./data/geographical-info/00.exp2_ADI_income_info.csv")
```
